S2.headline: Sale lost on a transient error
S2.fixSummary: Send one PayPal-Request-Id with the capture and retry a transient (5xx) outcome a few times with backoff, reusing the same request id so a retry can never capture twice.

S3.headline: Buyer charged twice
S3.fixSummary: When the capture call gives no usable answer, ask PayPal with GET order and take the result from reconciliationFrom instead of assuming failure. Only report FAILED if PayPal shows no capture or cannot be reached.

S4.headline: Order shipped twice
S4.fixSummary: Claim the event id and apply its effect in one step with applyEventOnce, and return outcome duplicate without fulfilling when the event was already processed.

S5.headline: Refunded order shown as paid
S5.fixSummary: On each relevant event, read the order from PayPal with getOrder and derive the status from that response instead of from the event type. Apply it with applyEventOnce, so a replay of the same event id does nothing and fulfilment only happens when PayPal reports the capture as paid.

S6.headline: Forged refund accepted
S6.fixSummary: Verify the delivery with verifyWebhookSignature, using the raw body, the transmission headers and PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID, before touching any state. Reject missing or failed verification with 4xx, answer 5xx when verification cannot be done so PayPal retries, and only then apply the event.
